Zero Horner iterations bypass Horner/CPE optimization. Direct lowering visits Atom operands, allocates temporaries, then sorts the resulting operand slots.

Float addition rounds and updates precision based on operand exponents and precision; changed arithmetic order can change values and precision metadata.
